world.h: Iran says ready for all scenarios as talks go on
world.b: "We are prepared for all scenarios," Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said, as Trump called the talks "fine" but said Iranian authorities were not "reliable".

world.h: Israeli drone strike kills five Gaza police
world.b: An Israeli drone attack killed five Palestinian police officers in al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, on Sunday; at least eight Palestinians were killed across Gaza.
world.title: At least eight Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza

world.h: Iran says two tankers on fire in Hormuz
world.b: Iran says two tankers are on fire in the Strait of Hormuz as Trump again says the war will end soon. Al Jazeera is following the Iran war live.
world.title: Iran says 2 tankers on fire in Hormuz; Trump again claims war will end soon

national.h: All 9 aboard die in Florida jet crash
national.b: The Bahamas-bound Learjet 60 crashed near a roadway in Palm Beach County and exploded, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said.
national.title: All 9 people aboard a jet that crashed in Florida have died, transportation secretary says

national.h: Halloween weekend shootings hit nightlife districts
national.b: Four people died and 15 were injured in shootings in Dallas's Deep Ellum, and college towns including Fayetteville and Bloomington reported shootings too.
national.title: Shootings over Halloween weekend leave at least 6 dead and dozens injured across U.S.

national.h: ICE officer to surrender in Houston car strike
national.b: Indicted on an aggravated assault charge, the officer plans to turn himself in Monday, his attorney said. The man he hit with his SUV on Oct. 10 broke his leg.

national.h: Supreme Court weighs religious schools in Colorado pre-K
national.b: At issue is whether religious schools in the state's universal pre-K program may refuse children of gay and trans parents despite a state anti-discrimination law.

politics.h: DOJ seeks sanctions over noncitizen list analysis
politics.b: The Justice Department says CHIRLA and its lawyers should face contempt after publishing an analysis finding over 40% of names on its California list are not on voter rolls.
politics.title: Justice Department urges sanctions for database analysis critical of its noncitizen voting claims

politics.h: Judge tosses bid to block Alaska Senate results
politics.b: Judge Sharon Gleason ruled the federal government cannot bring the suit, and that blocking certification would likely violate voters' right to a secret ballot.
politics.title: Judge tosses Trump's attempt to block Alaska Senate results if GOP incumbent loses

politics.h: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized after stroke
politics.b: The Connecticut Democrat, 53, felt numbness in his arm at his son's hockey game and is at Johns Hopkins; his chief of staff expects a full recovery.
politics.title: Connecticut Senator Chris Murphy is hospitalized with a stroke

politics.h: Stevens endorses GOP's Rogers in Michigan Senate race
politics.b: Democrat Haley Stevens backed Trump-backed Mike Rogers over nominee Abdul El-Sayed, saying El-Sayed told her she was no longer welcome in his campaign.
politics.title: El-Sayed's primary opponent stuns Democrats by endorsing Republican opponent in Michigan Senate race

politics.h: Sullivan says Peltola 'still lying' on ballot
politics.b: Two days before Election Day, Sullivan said Peltola lied about her campaign's role in a second Sullivan appearing on the Alaska Senate ballot.

politics.h: Trump reflects on rallies in final midterm stops
politics.b: In South Carolina, Trump told supporters 'you'll never see it happen again' while boosting Senate picks Darline Graham and Michael Whatley.

international.h: UN warns of risks as Western Sahara mission ends
international.b: Secretary-General Antonio Guterres confirmed the 35-year peacekeeping mission ended and warned hostilities could escalate.
international.title: UN warns of security risks in Western Sahara as peacekeeping mission ends

international.h: Israel says vote stands despite interference claims
international.b: Elections committee head Noam Sohlberg said results would stand even if suspicions of foreign interference were substantiated.
international.title: Israeli officials say results stand as Netanyahu claims election ‘stolen’

international.h: Israel's first envoy to Somaliland presents credentials
international.b: Officials also laid the cornerstone for an Israeli embassy in Hargeisa, after Israel became the first UN member to recognise Somaliland last December.
international.title: Israel’s first ambassador to Somaliland presents credentials in Hargeisa

international.h: Russia detains minor over alleged Moscow plot
international.b: The FSB said the suspect posted TikTok photos in tactical clothing holding what appeared to be an automatic weapon.
international.title: Russia detains minor over alleged Moscow attack plot after US warning

international.h: Carney reports progress in trade talks with Trump
international.b: The Canadian prime minister said teams will work in the coming weeks on a deal, after talks broke down in August and Trump imposed 50% tariffs.
international.title: Canada's Carney reports progress in trade talks with U.S. and Trump talks up 'concept' of a deal

international.h: Israel faces weeks of coalition wrangling
international.b: Neither the bloc around Netanyahu nor the Jewish parties opposing him won a majority in the 120-seat Knesset, leaving no clear path to a new government.

international.h: Thousands in Delhi demand election chief resign
international.b: Rahul Gandhi led Sunday's protest over voter list revisions that opposition parties say favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling party.

international.h: Qatar LNG carrier struck by 'unidentified objects'
international.b: The Qatari owner said its Al Mayeda was hit in the Gulf Friday evening; no crew were injured, no environmental damage was reported and the ship is in safe condition.

international.h: Rubio says US did not help Bolsonaro flee Brazil
international.b: Flavio Bolsonaro, under investigation in Brazil for alleged corruption and money laundering, arrived in Miami after the State Department said his family would get US visas.

international.h: Bangladesh forms wage board as garment protests go on
international.b: Thousands of workers demanding higher wages kept protesting around Dhaka despite the announcement; police fired tear gas and sound grenades.

sports.h: Bucs win without a single completion
sports.b: In heavy rain, Baker Mayfield went 0-for-3 as Tampa Bay ran for 324 yards to beat Atlanta, the first completion-less win since 1974.
sports.title: Baker Mayfield, Buccaneers complete win against Falcons with statistics not seen since 1933

sports.h: Cowboys collapse, Burrow makes history in Week 8
sports.b: Dallas blew a fourth-quarter lead to Arizona in overtime, and Joe Burrow posted a stat line no quarterback has since the merger.
sports.title: NFL Week 8 winners and losers: Cowboys suffer epic collapse, Joe Burrow delivers historic heroics

sports.h: Almgren, Chepkirui win New York City Marathon
sports.b: Sweden's Almgren won his marathon debut in 2:06:01, the course's third-fastest time, and Kenya's Sheila Chepkirui won the women's race for a second time.
sports.title: New York City Marathon: Sweden's Almgren and Kenya's Chepkirui win as 60,000 take part

sports.h: Ravens turn to third QB Joe Fagnano vs. Bills
sports.b: Lamar Jackson hurt his thumb on the first play and Tyler Huntley injured his foot, forcing the undrafted UConn rookie into the game.
Despite a $46 million buyout, the Seminoles moved on after a 36-24 home loss to Clemson on Saturday.

sports.h: Texas gets a B, Ole Miss an A- in Week 9 grades
sports.b: No. 3 Georgia, No. 11 Texas and No. 12 Ole Miss cruised, while No. 1 Miami and No. 4 Indiana squeaked out close wins over unranked foes.

sports.h: Bowl projections reshuffled after wild Week 9
sports.b: USC's upset of Ohio State, Miami's escape at North Carolina and Georgia's rout of Florida reshape projections ahead of Tuesday's first CFP Rankings.

sports.h: Valkyries win WNBA title as Williams stars in Game 7
sports.b: Finals MVP Gabby Williams scored 30 points, 28 in the second half, with four blocks to lead Golden State to the championship.
The win puts Lincoln Riley's Trojans back in the College Football Playoff discussion, with games against Indiana and unbeaten UCLA still ahead.
Five AP Top 25 teams fell in the first two windows, three to unranked foes. No. 3 Georgia routed Florida, while No. 25 Wisconsin's season slid to a halt.

sports.h: Police records: three more women accused Jacobs
sports.b: Records released to NBC 26 show three other women accused the Packers RB of abuse after his May arrest on domestic abuse charges; he has denied the allegations.

sports.h: Colts in Jonathan Taylor trade talks
sports.b: Indianapolis (2-5), which already dealt Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner this week, has received at least one offer including a second-round pick, per ESPN. Taylor says he hasn't requested a trade.

local.h: Council to review NYC snow removal plans
local.b: The sanitation committee meets Monday and will weigh a bill requiring the city to publish snowplowing records on PlowNYC.
local.title: NYC Council to scrutinize snow removal plans as winter approaches

local.h: NYC Marathon kicks off under brisk skies
local.b: Runners set off from Staten Island Sunday morning in the high 40s as crowds cheered in Bay Ridge near the Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge.
local.title: A 'beautiful' day for a marathon, as runners, spectators pack NYC streets

localgood.h: Clinton Hill throws its 'mile nine' marathon party
localgood.b: Thousands of revelers packed Brooklyn's brownstone-lined streets near mile nine to cheer on runners.
localgood.title: 'The best day of the year': Inside Clinton Hill's 'mile nine' NYC marathon party

localgood.b: The Southern Taurids peak Nov. 4-5 with about five bright, slow meteors per hour, and Saturn and Jupiter are good viewing this month.
localgood.title: November has 3 meteor showers and the best chance to see Uranus
